protocol.order: round 0/2 A, A-control, B; round 1 B, A-control, A; fresh child process and copied fixture per job
protocol.fixture: synthetic committed state: 1 observation + 1 canonical knowledge row per history entry, built by the released normalisation functions; frozen clock and UUID sequence
protocol.firstWrite: one new-subject observe on the seeded over-limit document (legacy partition migration), then restart
protocol.steady: new subject, cold subject repeat, hot subject repeat, 32 concurrent observes
protocol.read: experience recall and knowledge query after the steady writes
